1.name: Asa Newell
1.comment: Newell (toe)  is out for Saturday's game against the Nets.

1.name: Keshon Gilbert
1.comment: Gilbert (knee) is out for Saturday's game against Brooklyn.

1.name: Jock Landale
1.comment: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nets.

1.name: Mouhamed Gueye
1.comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

1.name: Henri Veesaar
1.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

2.name: Mitchell Robinson
2.comment: Robinson (illness) is questionable for Sunday's game versus Milwaukee, Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com reports.

3.name: Yves Missi
3.comment: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

4.name: Norman Powell
4.comment: Powell (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the 76ers.

4.name: Tobe Awaka
4.comment: Awaka (knee) is questionable for Sundays' game against the 76ers.

4.name: Jalen Smith
4.comment: Smith (finger) is probable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

4.name: Nic Claxton
4.comment: Claxton (hamstring) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against the 76ers.

4.name: Zach Collins
4.comment: Collins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

5.name: Sam Merrill
5.comment: Merrill (elbow) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

5.name: Jarrett Allen
5.comment: Allen (knee) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks

5.name: Jaylon Tyson
5.comment: Tyson (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

6.name: Sergio de Larrea
6.comment: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.

6.name: Tarik Biberovic
6.comment: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

6.name: Dereck Lively II
6.comment: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.

7.name: Julian Strawther
7.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

8.name: Jalen Duren
8.comment: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

8.name: Isaiah Joe
8.comment: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lakers.

9.name: Kristaps Porzingis
9.comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

9.name: Moses Moody
9.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

9.name: Jimmy Butler III
9.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

10.name: Clint Capela
10.comment: Capela (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Suns.

10.name: Steven Adams
10.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Wednesday that Adams (calf) is still without a timetable to return and will be evaluated on a "weekly basis," Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.

11.name: Tyrese Haliburton
11.comment: Haliburton (hamstring) is progressing well but does not have a timetable to return, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

11.name: Johnny Furphy
11.comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

11.name: Ben Sheppard
11.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

12.name: Brandon Ingram
12.comment: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Sunday's game against New Orleans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

12.name: Isaiah Jackson
12.comment: Jackson (groin) won't suit up for Sunday's game against the Pelicans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

12.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
12.comment: The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

12.name: Bradley Beal
12.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

12.name: Jordan Miller
12.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

13.name: Luka Doncic
13.comment: Doncic has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Detroit due to lower-back tightness, Trevor Lane of LakersNation.com reports.

15.name: Gary Trent Jr.
15.comment: Trent (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against Boston.

16.name: Anthony Edwards
16.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

16.name: Donte DiVincenzo
16.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

17.name: Grant Nelson
17.comment: Nelson signed a two-way contract with the Nets on Friday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

17.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
17.comment: Brown, who finished with 18 points (5-13 FG, 3-8 3Pt, 5-7 FT), one rebound, three assists and one steal over 25 minutes in Saturday's 124-121 loss to Atlanta, won't play in Sunday's game against Dallas, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.

17.name: Egor Demin
17.comment: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

18.name: Josh Hart
18.comment: Hart is out for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to right ankle soreness.

19.name: Desmond Bane
19.comment: Bane (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Warriors.

19.name: Jonathan Isaac
19.comment: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Wednesday.

19.name: Jalen Suggs
19.comment: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

19.name: Paolo Banchero
19.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

19.name: Noah Penda
19.comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

19.name: Izaiyah Nelson
19.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

20.name: Joel Embiid
20.comment: Embiid (foot) is probable for Sunday's game against the Bulls.

20.name: Adem Bona
20.comment: Bona (back) is out for Sunday's game in Chicago.

20.name: Dominick Barlow
20.comment: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

20.name: Ariel Hukporti
20.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

21.name: Jordan Goodwin
21.comment: Goodwin (calf) is out for Saturday's game against the Rockets.

21.name: Mark Williams
21.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

22.name: Robert Williams III
22.comment: Williams (rest) won't play in Saturday's game against the Spurs.

22.name: Ja Morant
22.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

22.name: Vit Krejci
22.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

22.name: Shaedon Sharpe
22.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

23.name: Keegan Murray
23.comment: Murray (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Heat.

23.name: Maxime Raynaud
23.comment: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

23.name: Ben Simmons
23.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

24.name: Tobias Harris
24.comment: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

24.name: Jayden Quaintance
24.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

25.name: Jaylin Williams
25.comment: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Wizards, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

25.name: Thomas Sorber
25.comment: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

25.name: Cason Wallace
25.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

25.name: Chet Holmgren
25.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

25.name: Jalen Williams
25.comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

26.name: Keyonte George
26.comment: George (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against Minnesota.

26.name: Lauri Markkanen
26.comment: Markkanen is questionable for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to a right wrist sprain.

26.name: Jusuf Nurkic
26.comment: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

26.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
26.comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

27.name: Anthony Davis
27.comment: Davis (ankle) won't play Saturday against the Thunder.

27.name: Deandre Ayton
27.comment: Ayton won't return to Saturday's game against the Thunder due to a lower leg injury.

27.name: Reece Beekman
27.comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

27.name: Tristan Vukcevic
27.comment: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.

27.name: Justin Champagnie
27.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

27.name: Jamir Watkins
27.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

28.name: Immanuel Quickley
28.comment: Quickley (hamstring) was a limited participant in Sunday's practice and will be listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

28.name: Scottie Barnes
28.comment: Barnes (adductor) was a limited participant in Sunday's practice and will be listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

28.name: Kawhi Leonard
28.comment: Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

28.name: Nate Bittle
28.comment: Bittle (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Clippers and remains without a timetable to return.

29.name: Richie Saunders
29.comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

29.name: Isaiah Stewart
29.comment: Stewart (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

29.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
29.comment: Pippen (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Oklahoma City.

30.name: Moussa Diabate
30.comment: Diabate (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Boston, according to the Hornets' official injury report.

30.name: Brandon Miller
30.comment: Head coach Charles Lee said Miller (groin) will be re-evaluated over the weekend, and they expect to have more information by Monday, Steve Reed of The Associated Press reports.

30.name: Dennis Schroder
30.comment: Schroder (thigh) is out for Friday's game versus Boston.

30.name: Kon Knueppel
30.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.

30.name: Grant Williams
30.comment: The Hornets recalled Williams (hamstring) from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Wednesday.
